notes: SEMANTICALLY LIKELY UNRELATED to 'texture loading' despite the class name - operates entirely on widget/interface data: checks/sets a per-interface 'already loaded' flag (AudioResampler.aBooleanArray2162[interfaceId]), and if the underlying Js5 group (RenderConfigFactory.aJs5Archive_2978, group=interfaceId) exists with N files, lazily allocates and fills WarpTextureNode.aWidgetComponentArrayArray9427[interfaceId] with N WidgetComponent instances (each parsed via widgetComponent.method433(ByteBuffer(bytes), true) from file `i_2_` of the group, encoding a packed `childIndex + (interfaceId shl 16)` id into anInt830). This is the standard 'lazily decode every child component of an interface the first time it's needed' pattern used throughout the widget system (compare WidgetCache.kt). Returns true once the interface's components are loaded (or already were).
